title: Structured-Token Attention for Fine-Grained mmWave Liquid Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.27512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-grained liquid identification requires a classifier to distinguish similar substances from compact millimeter-wave measurements. We investigate structured-token attention, which represents a radar feature tensor through complementary antenna, feature, branch, and global views. The proposed StructAttn model embeds these views into eleven tokens and combines them with a three-layer transformer. Experiments on the public FG-LiquID data cover 30 liquids and 3,000 samples. Over five seeds on the released split, StructAttn achieves 96.70\% mean best-epoch accuracy, matching the original-recipe MMNet baseline and exceeding a scalar-token attention model by 1.50 percentage points. A five-seed probability ensemble reaches 97\%, corresponding to 18 errors among 600 test samples. translated_title: 用于细粒度毫米波液体识别的结构化令牌注意力
translated_abstract: 细粒度液体识别要求分类器能够从紧凑的毫米波测量数据中区分相似物质。我们研究了结构化令牌注意力方法，它通过互补的天线、特征、分支和全局视图来表示雷达特征张量。所提出的 StructAttn 模型将这些视图嵌入为十一个令牌，并将其与三层 transformer 结合。在公开的 FG-LiquID 数据上的实验涵盖 30 种液体和 3,000 个样本。在发布的数据划分上进行五个随机种子实验，StructAttn 达到 96.70% 的平均最佳轮次准确率，与原始配方 MMNet 基线持平，并比标量令牌注意力模型高出 1.50 个百分点。五种子概率集成达到 97% 的准确率，相当于 600 个测试样本中仅有 18 个错误。最终轮次和五折结果补充了基于检查点选择的比较，StructAttn 获得 95.30% 的折外准确率。令牌与特征分析表明（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出 StructAttn 模型，将毫米波雷达特征张量以天线、特征、分支和全局四个互补视图表示为结构化令牌并结合三层 transformer 注意力机制，在 FG-LiquID 数据集上实现了对 30 种液体的细粒度识别，最佳准确率达 96.70%，集成后达 97%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes StructAttn, which embeds radar feature tensors into eleven structured tokens representing complementary antenna, feature, branch, and global views and processes them with a three-layer transformer, achieving 96.70% mean accuracy (97% with five-seed ensembling) on fine-grained mmWave identification of 30 liquids.
